script: There's a lot of psychological facts about falling in love that you should never ignore. Number one: love takes months to become real. without even knowing it. Go ahead, try this: Open WhatsApp and look at who's second in your chat. Number two: no matter how angry you get, you'll end up forgiving her. Number three: many people are already talking to their soulmate. Number four: people fall for consistency, not words. Show up the same way for three months, and she'll notice. Number five: if she cries over you, she's not leaving, it means you matter. Comment FACTS, and I'll send you my free playbook.
